UserName.description: User name of the target Orchard user the entitlement is applied to. Entries without a user name are skipped.

DisplayName.description: Display name for the agent. When empty, the resolved user name is used.

MaxConcurrentInteractions.description: Maximum number of interactions the agent may handle at once. Values below 1 are raised to 1.

items.description: A queue identifier the agent is entitled to. Identifiers that no longer exist are filtered out.

AllowedQueueIds.description: Queue identifiers the agent is entitled to work.

items.description: A campaign identifier the agent is entitled to. Identifiers that no longer exist are filtered out.

AllowedCampaignIds.description: Campaign identifiers the agent is entitled to work.

items.description: A skill identifier granted to the agent.

Skills.description: Skill identifiers granted to the agent.

Proficiency.description: How well the agent holds the skill, from 1 to 5.

SkillProficiencies.description: How well the agent holds each skill. Skills listed only in 'Skills' are read at the default proficiency.

QueueId.description: The queue the membership is for.

Priority.description: How strongly the agent is pulled toward this queue; lower is served first.

DelaySeconds.description: How long an item must have waited before this agent is offered it, which is how a backup (overflow) membership is expressed.

QueueMemberships.description: How the agent serves each queue: its priority and the wait before the agent is offered work from it.

Agents.description: The Contact Center agent entitlements to create or update.
